draft.shortGloss: to repair; to fix; to correct; to redo
draft.emotion: focused and competent, feeling the satisfaction of solving a problem
notes: Godan transitive verb (直します). Its intransitive pair is 直る (なおる, to be fixed / to get better).
Often confused with the homophone 治す (なおす), which is used specifically for curing illnesses or healing injuries.
Attached to the stem (ます-form minus ます) of another verb, it means to do that action over again (e.g. 書き直す, to rewrite).
